summary: This Form 6-K filed by Prudential plc on June 12, 2026, reports routine notifications of transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMRs) under the company's All Employee Share Purchase Plan. The CFO, Chief HR Officer, Chief Risk and Compliance Officer, and a business CEO each acquired small numbers of ordinary shares at GBP 9.165605 per share on the London Stock Exchange on June 10, 2026. These are standard share plan transactions, not a special situation. No event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved. This is a routine disclosure of director/PDMR dealings.
